pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions or opening multi-ticket clusters within a 5-second execution window during high ATR expansion regimes.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order dispatch unless the 14-period ATR is below the 50-period median and the order flow imbalance confirms direction via tick volume delta.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instant trailing stop lock-in at +$4.00, with scaling partial exits starting at +$15.00 and final liquidation before +$30.00.
